"""Constructor-based circle packing for n=26 circles"""
import numpy as np


def construct_packing():
    n=26;rc=[5,5,6,5,5];m=.02;ny=len(rc);dy=(1-2*m)/(ny-1);C=[]
    for r,nc in enumerate(rc):
        y=m+r*dy;dx=(1-2*m)/nc;x0=m+dx/2+(dx/2 if r&1 else 0)
        for c in range(nc):
            x=x0+c*dx
            if x>1-m: x-=dx
            C.append((x,y))
    centers=np.array(C[:n],float)
    for t in range(35):  # cheap deterministic relaxation (repulsion + wall)
        d=centers[:,None]-centers[None,:]
        w=1/((d*d).sum(2)+np.eye(n));w[np.eye(n,dtype=bool)]=0
        f=(w[:,:,None]*d).sum(1)
        x,y=centers[:,0],centers[:,1]
        f+=np.c_[1/((x-m)**2+1e-6)-1/((1-m-x)**2+1e-6),
                 1/((y-m)**2+1e-6)-1/((1-m-y)**2+1e-6)]
        a=.06*(1-t/35);centers=np.clip(centers+a*f/(np.linalg.norm(f,1) +1e-9),m,1-m)
    radii=compute_max_radii(centers);return centers,radii,float(radii.sum())


def compute_max_radii(centers):
    n=centers.shape[0]
    d=centers[:,None]-centers[None,:]
    D=np.sqrt((d*d).sum(2))+np.eye(n)*1e9
    wall=np.min(np.c_[centers[:,0],centers[:,1],1-centers[:,0],1-centers[:,1]],1)
    r=wall.copy()
    for _ in range(80):
        r2=np.minimum(wall,np.min(D-r[None,:],1));r2=np.maximum(r2,1e-9)
        if np.max(np.abs(r2-r))<1e-12: break
        r=r2
    return r

def visualize(centers, radii):
    """
    Visualize the circle packing

    Args:
        centers: np.array of shape (n, 2) with (x, y) coordinates
        radii: np.array of shape (n) with radius of each circle
    """
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.patches import Circle

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 8))

    # Draw unit square
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.grid(True)

    # Draw circles
    for i, (center, radius) in enumerate(zip(centers, radii)):
        circle = Circle(center, radius, alpha=0.5)
        ax.add_patch(circle)
        ax.text(center[0], center[1], str(i), ha="center", va="center")

    plt.title(f"Circle Packing (n={len(centers)}, sum={sum(radii):.6f})")
    plt.show()
